description: Defines interfaces and classes for message output and publishing within the WPEFramework, including JSON formatting, console, syslog, file, UDP, and WebSocket outputs, as well as an IPublish interface.

classes.name: IPublish
classes.description: Interface for publishing messages with a Message method.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Class for converting message metadata to string format.

classes.name: ConsoleOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to the console.

classes.name: SyslogOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to syslog.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that outputs messages to a file.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: Class for formatting message data as JSON, with configurable output options.

classes.name: UDPOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that sends messages over UDP.

classes.name: WebSocketOutput
classes.description: Implementation of IPublish that manages WebSocket connections for message output, including channel management and JSON data formatting.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Virtual method in IPublish for outputting a message with metadata.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Method in Text class to convert message metadata to string.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Method in Channel class to send data over UDP.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to initialize with a service and max connections.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Method in WebSocketOutput to clean up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Method to attach a new WebSocket channel.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Method to detach a WebSocket channel.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Method to process received configuration commands for WebSocket channels.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Method to publish a message to all connected channels.
